name: RA2 Toolbox 1.0.39-pre.7
source: Current rendering branch: x64 external host with x86 GameRuntime and hook broker; optional isolated DLSS5 neural renderer
resources: Update package reuses existing assets/profiles/preprocessing runtime/engine
validation: verify_crossbit_abi.py compares actual Windows x86/x64 wire declarations; verify_windows_outputs.py verifies exact PE architectures and current exported protocol; Windows broker and rendering CI are required for the final build
build_requirement: Zig0.13.0; defaultx86 paired build or isolatedx64 host+x86 runtime/broker. Optional neural helper uses MSVC2022 x64 and separately fetched NVIDIA NGX SDK.
package_type: Architecture-labelled experimental update; exact output PE metadata is generated by verify_windows_outputs.py, not inferred from historical tracked output manifests
game_code_patching: This host/renderer migration adds no game code patches and retains the existing strict-no-code-writes baseline
input_entry: Manager WH_GETMESSAGE / WH_CALLWNDPROCRET only; features have no independent hooks
symbolic_original_interfaces: EventClass original constructors + SP DoList / MP OutList
DisplayClass::ScrollMap (0x4A9840), rate-scaled adapter for experimental scrolling
release_status: 1.0.39-pre.7; prerelease publication requires the final same-commit build and frontend checks
frontend: Independent settings input queues; latest-layout snapshots; dependency gating; explicit key gestures; page-only wheel scrolling
technology_experiment: Native AddCameo + two local UI CanBuild limit-only callsite wrappers; native factories/events unchanged; no live purchase/netplay certification
calculation_locations: Thirteen tactical decision families selectable; native queries/events always GameRuntime; statistics/reservations/display external.
player_control: Experimental shared control retained; current-player switching and enemy-building Sell disabled
refresh_experiment: Cursor high refresh enabled; scene/forced refresh and view zoom entries disabled

dlss5.backend: optional NVIDIA NGX Neural Rendering in isolated x64 helper
